about_short_description.short_description: TaxGPT uses artificial intelligence and tax information to automate tax filing.

product.name: TaxGPT Co-Pilot
product.description: An AI workspace for tax professionals that combines tax research, document analysis, tax writing, client communications, and return review in one workflow.

product.name: TaxGPT Cowork
product.description: An agentic automation platform for tax, accounting, and advisory firms that executes recurring workflows inside existing tax, accounting, and practice-management software.

product.name: Tax Research
product.description: An AI tax research tool that answers complex federal, state, local, Canadian, and selected international tax questions with citations to authoritative sources.

product.name: Tax Preparation
product.description: An AI tax preparation agent that prepares tax returns inside existing professional tax software and provides explanations for return entries.

product.name: Client Intelligence
product.description: An AI-powered client and entity information system that organizes documents, filing history, ownership relationships, tax positions, and client context for personalized workflows.

product.name: Agent Andrew
product.description: An AI-powered tax return review tool that analyzes prepared returns and source documents to identify errors, audit risks, and potential tax-saving opportunities.
